content: Phexroosa Bolla Shiiqida Walassa Qaala
Hawaaretinne Yuhudan diza ammanizayti Ayzaabeti Xoossa qaala ekkidayssa siyida.
Hessa gishshas Phexroosi pude Yerusalaame keziin qaxxarettida Ayhudappe ammanizayti Phexroosa,
«Ne qaxxarettontta asata keeth gelada isttara kath madasa» giidi walassida.
Phexroosi qasse isttas gelana mala maarara hizgi yootides.
«Tani Iyophphe kataman woossishin dhisko mala tana liphiphi histtidi ajjuutan gita may7o misatiza miishshi oyddu baggara oykettidi saloppe ta dizaso wodhdhishin beyadis.
Ta tishshi histta xeellishin oyddu tohora diza meheta, wora do7ata, biitta bolla gooshettiza medheteththatanne salo bolla piradhdhiza kafota beyadis.
Heerakka tana, ‹Phexroosa denda! Hayssa shukkada ma› giza qaala siyadis.
«Tanikka, ‹Godoo hessi hanenna; tani tuna woykko geesh gidonttayssa mulekka ta doonaakko shiishsha erikke› gadis.
«He kase qaalay qasseka, ‹Xoossi geeshshidayssa ne tunisoppa› giidi saloppe taas yootides.
Hessika heedzdzuto shiretti shiretti yootettidaappe guye wurikka simmidi pude salo bides.
«Qisaariyappe taakko kiitettida heedzdzu asati heerakka he saateyin yi gakkidi ta diza keeththa karen eqqida.
Ta aynne sidhontta isttara baana mala Xillo Ayanay taas yootides. He usuppun ishati tanara issife biidi addeza keeththe gelidos.
Izikka Xoossa kiitanchchay iza keeththan eqqidi izas beettidayssa, ‹Iyophphe geetettizaso as yeddada Phexroosa geetettiza Simoona xeygisa.
Izi yiidi nenanne neso asaa ubbaa ashshana qaala yootana› gidayssa nuus yootides.
«Tanikka baada buro yooto oykkishin koyro Xillo Ayanay kase nu bolla wodhdhoyssaththo istta bollaka wodhdhides.
Kase Goday nuus yootishe, ‹Yohannisi haaththan xammaqides; intte gidikko Xillo Ayanan xammaqettana› gida qaalay heerakka taas qofettides.
Hessa gishshas nuni Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa ammanishin nuus immida Xillo Ayana Xoossi isttas immiko histtiin Xoossara eqettanaas tani oonee?» gides.
Istti hessa siyida wode isttas gizaazi dhayiin co7u gi simmidi, «Hayssa mala gidikko Ayzaabetikka ha ooraththa de7okko yaana mala Xoossi asas maaroteth immides guussa» giidi Xoossaa galatida.
Anxokiyan Diza Woosa Keeththayo
Isttifaanose bolla dendida goodeteththa gaason laalettida ammaniza asay qaalaa Ayhudatas xalala yootishe Pinqe, Qophiroosenne Anxokiya geetettizaso gakkanaas kanththi bida.
Qophirooseppenne Qareenappe yida issi issi asati Anxokiya biidi Giriketaska Godaa Yesusa Mishiraachcho qaalaa yootida.
Godaa maadoykka isttara dees; qoodan keehi daro asay ammanidi Godaakko simmides.
Hessa woreykka Yerusalaamen diza Woosa Keeththa asaa hayththan wodhdhiin Woosa Keeththaya Barnabaasa Anxokiya yeddadus.
Izikka hee bi gakkidi Xoossi ba aadho kiyateth deraas immidayssa be7idi ufayettidessinne asay wurikka kumeththa wozinappe Godaa ammanon minnana mala zorides.
Izikka Xillo Ayananinne ammanon kumida lo7o asa. Daro derey Godaa ammanidi gujettides.
Hessafe kaallidi Barnabaasi Sa7oole koyana Xarseese bides.
Iza demmidi Anxokiya ekki yides; nam7ayka heen diza Woosa Keeththa asaara gididi layth kumeth daro dere tamaarsida. Heen Anxokiyan ammanizayti koyro, «Kirsaane» geetetti xeygettida.
He wode issi issi nabeti Yerusalaameppe duge Anxokiya wodhdhida.

Istta giddofe issoy Agaboosa geetettizayssi dendi eqqidi Xillo Ayanay iza bessiin alame ubbaan gita koshay dendanayssa yootides. Hessika Oroome kawo Qalawodoosa Qeesaare geetettizayssa kawoteththa wode polettides.
Ammanizayti wuri issoy issoy ba wolqqa keena miishshe kesettidi Yuhudan diza ammaniza ishata maaddanaas qachchida.
Maado miish kesettidi Barnabaasanne Sa7oole kushen cimatas gaththana mala yeddida.
